_meta.note: Copy catalogue for the reshaped journey (Stakes Journey.dc.html, frames 01–12). Existing keys keep their repo values unless listed under changed. Every string the new screens render is here — nothing is left inline in JSX.

placeholders.{closeTime}: local time the rolling 24h day ends, e.g. 06:41
placeholders.{label}: challenge title, e.g. Move every day

rules: Money is always digits, never words: 300 NIM, not three hundred.
Never name what is still ahead — no days remaining, no NIM still to earn. Only today and what is behind.
Never say midnight. The day closes 24h after the free tap; name the real close time and the hours left.
Labels, eyebrows and numbers are mono uppercase; headlines and body are Young Serif / Hanken.
changed: rs.taste.hTop / hLead / hEm / hTail → single headline rs.taste.h
rs.taste.sub — now names the free day and the ask
rs.official.lengthLabel — 'For how long' → 'Hold me to it for'
rs.banked.moneyLbl — unchanged text, now set in mono on both the win and partial cards
rs.day.toGo — removed from the UI (names what is ahead)

gate.sub: Stakes runs inside Nimiq Pay. Tap to open, and you’re in.
gate.reassure: First time? Nimiq Pay may ask you to confirm. That’s normal.
gate.get: Don’t have it? Get Nimiq Pay
gate.foot: A commitment game built on trust, not surveillance.
gate.guarantee: Held safe, and back in your pocket.
gate.scanSub: Stakes lives on your phone. Scan the code to open it in Nimiq Pay.
gate.scanCap: Point your phone camera at the code.

share.sealDay1: Day one, on the record. {emoji} {goal}. I'm in.
share.bankedWeek: Banked the week. {emoji} {goal}. Run it back?
share.perfectWeek: Seven for seven. {emoji} {goal}. A clean week.

clock.openUntil: This day closes at {closeTime} tomorrow — {hoursLeft} hours left.

dot.intro: I'm the dot. When the day gets tricky, tap me.

steady.day: Not feeling it? Tap me and I'll talk you into it.
steady.sheet: You don't have to want it. You only have to start it, and starting takes ninety seconds.
steady.sheetSub: Put your shoes on and stand by the door. If you still don't want to go, come back and tell me.

dry.sheet: Thirty minutes. You have done it twice this week, so you know it is survivable.
dry.sheetSub: Start the clock and stop negotiating. The negotiation is the hard part, not the moving.

warm.sheet: Nobody feels like it. The ones who keep going just stopped waiting to feel like it.
warm.sheetSub: Go gently, go badly, go for five minutes. It counts the same on the record.

unprompted.slipHour: This is the hour you usually talk yourself out of it.
unprompted.afterMiss: The day after a miss is the one that decides it. Want a hand?

dot.stake: Backing your word is the easy part. I'm here for the rest.
dot.banked: Seven for seven. Say the word and we go again.
dot.partial: Same thing again? You know the two days that got you. So do I.
dot.record: Pick the thing you keep putting off. I'll be there for the hard days.

taste.h: That took nerve. Now live the day.
taste.sub: Day one is on the clock and it's free. Do it once today and it's yours.
taste.caption: Day one · free · nothing at stake yet

official.h: Put a little money on your word.
official.sub: Keep the day, keep the money. Keep them all and you get a completion bonus on top.
official.ticketTerms: {amount} NIM held · {perDay} back each day you keep
official.backdateLead: Day one is already on the clock.
official.backdateBold: Check in today and it's the first one you keep.
official.needNim: You need about {need} NIM in your wallet to put it on your word.
official.err: That didn’t go through. Tap to try again.
official.errCancel: You didn’t confirm, so nothing was taken. Put it on your word when you’re ready.

day.sub: Do it once today, any way you like. This day closes at {closeTime} {when} — {hoursLeft} hours left.
day.ridingNote: Win it and it's yours. That's the only number that matters right now.
day.dayOnePrompt: You're in. Now check in to keep day one.
day.sealedSub: {amount} NIM is now yours to lose only by stopping.
day.err: Could not seal today. Try again.

missed.subOne: One day, {amount} NIM, gone. Everything you kept is still yours, and today is open for another {hoursLeft} hours.
missed.subMany: {n} days, {amount} NIM, gone. Everything you kept is still yours, and today is open for another {hoursLeft} hours.
missed.ridingNote: A miss doesn't end the run. It only costs the day it took.

banked.partialCredit: {n} days you'd otherwise have talked yourself out of.
banked.wipeoutNote: No days kept, so nothing came back this time.

record.sub: Every day you've kept, and what each run paid back.

reup.sub: You’ve strung together more than most people ever do. Keep the chain alive.

archive.lead: Everything you’ve run. Tap one to run it again.
archive.metaLapsed: Ran out in 24h · never made official

lapsed.sub: Day one’s window closed before it became a real challenge. No harm done. Start a fresh one whenever you’re ready.

a11y.dotResting: The dot, resting. Tap for a word.
